overlayBoxes.title: MLRO Source-of-Funds Oversight Is a Glance, Not a Review
overlayBoxes.details: In interview, the Money Laundering Reporting Officer described her source-of-funds review as 'just glancing at the file' after the fee earner has signed it off, rather than conducting an independent assessment. The MLRO role requires substantive oversight, not mere confirmation that a fee earner has ticked a box.
